packageRules.description: One grouped weekly PR instead of one PR per dependency.
Runtime dependencies the mod is compiled and shipped against: always reviewed by a human, regardless of update size.
Build-time-only tooling (Gradle plugin, test framework): safe to auto-merge for patch/minor bumps.
GitHub Actions are build/CI tooling, not a production dependency: safe to auto-merge for patch/minor/digest bumps.
Never auto-merge a major bump, even for dev tooling.
